property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always reverts if any callee call to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) fails (reference enforces this by requiring success), whereas the mutant ignores failed external calls and can return true despite a callee reverting/failing.
change_summary: Change the require after the external call to a conditional that ignores the call failure (removes revert on call failure), so transfer returns true even if a callee call returned false.
